title: COSCO, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (5,041 affected)
summary: THE FOAM SEAT PAD OF THE CHILD SEAT IS NOT SEALED AT THE SEAMS, ALLOWING THE FOAM PAD TO BE ACCESSIBLE TO THE SEAT OCCUPANT.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: STEERING:GEAR:RACK (85 affected)
summary: ONE OR MORE OF THE BOLTS MOUNTING THE STEERING RACK TO THE CHASSIS OF THE VEHICLE MAY HAVE BEEN STRETCHED, DUE TO OVER TORQUING IN THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS, CAUSING SOME OF THE BOLTS TO LOOSEN.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY (57,000 affected)
summary: THE OWNER'S MANUAL INCORRECTLY STATES THAT THE FRONT PASSENGER DOOR CANNOT BE OPENED FROM THE INSIDE IF THE DOOR IS LOCKED UNTIL THE LOCK CONTROL HANDLE HAS BEEN PULLED UP. ON THESE VEHICLES, THE FRONT PASSENGER DOOR CAN BE OPENED BY THE INSIDE DOOR HANDLE EVEN IF THE DOOR IS LOCKED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:PADS AND SHOES (41,000 affected)
summary: THE BONDED DISC BRAKE LININGS MAY SEPARATE FROM THE SHOES DUE TO A BONDING DEFICIENCY WHICH MAY ALLOW CORROSION DEGRADATION OF THE BOND ATTACHMENT.

title: Caterpillar, Inc.: ENGINE (16,000 affected)
summary: THE GOVERNOR SERVO PIN ON THE ENGINE CAN COME OUT WHILE THE ENGINE IS OPERATING DUE TO LACK OF AN ADEQUATE PRESS FIT AND/OR INADEQUATE STAKING AT THE END OF THE PIN BORE.

title: KELLY SPRINGFIELD TIRE CO: TIRES (120 affected)
summary: AN INTERMITTENT FAILURE OF THE PRESS CURE TIMER CAUSED THE TIRES TO BE OVERCURED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STEERING:COLUMN SHAFT UPPER (20,000 affected)
summary: THE ZINC PLATING OPERATION PERFORMED ON THE UPPER STEERING COLUMN SHAFT COUPLING BOLT CAUSED HYDROGEN EMBRITTLEMENT AND BREAKAGE OF THE BOLT.

title: COLLINS AMBULANCE CORP.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:UNDER DASH (767 affected)
summary: THE WIRING LOOM IS ROUTED THROUGH AN AREA OF THE DASH WHERE THE EMERGENCY BRAKE ARM MAY CHAFE THE WIRING LOOM WHEN THE EMERGECY BRAKE IS DEPRESSED. WITHIN THE WIRING LOOM ARE TWO WIRES FOR THE AMMETER THAT DO NOT HAVE IN LINE CIRCUIT BREAKERS.

title: FRUEHAUF CORPORATION: WHEELS (126 affected)
summary: THE INNER WHEEL BEARING CONES WERE OMITTED FROM THE WHEEL ASSEMBLIES. MISSING INNER BEARING CONES CAN CAUSE OIL SEAL DETERIORATION OR CAUSE OVERHEATED BRAKES BECAUSE THE BRAKE DRUM COULD REST ON THE BRAKE LINING.

title: International Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (11,346 affected)
summary: THE SCHOOL BUS CHASSIS FAILED THE FMVSS 301 CRASH BARRIER TEST WHEN A RETURN FUEL HOSE WAS SEVERED, RESULTING IN A FUEL LOSS GREATER THAN THE AMOUNT ALLOWED BY THE STANDARD.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:INSTRUMENT PANEL:GAUGE:INDICATOR: (20 affected)
summary: INCORRECT INSTRUMENT PANEL WIRING ASSEMBLIES IN SOME VEHICLES WILL NOT ACTUATE THE "ANTI-LOCK" BRAKE WARNING LIGHTS.

title: THE NEW GOSHEN COACH CORP: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM (31 affected)
summary: THE RECTIFIER INSTALLED IN A VENTED COMPARTMENT IN THE PASSENGER SIDE STEPWELL OF THE VEHICLE OVERHEATS AND BREAKS DOWN DUE TO INADEQUATE VENTILATION.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (3,855 affected)
summary: THE FRONT BRAKE LINE HAS A POSSIBLE ASSEMBLY ERROR IN WHICH THERE IS INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE BRAKE LINE  AND THE POWER STEERING MOUNTING BRACKET.

title: Mazda North American Operations: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM:LININGS (95,074 affected)
summary: THE REAR BRAKE LININGS CAN CHANGE OVER TIME. AS THE BRAKES WEAR, THE COEFFICIENT OF FRICTION CAN INCREASE, PRODUCING INCONSISTENT REAR BRAKE PERFORMANCE AND PREMATURE ACTIVATION OF THE ABS SYSTEM.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (175,923 affected)
summary: LIQUID SPILLED IN THE CONSOLE AREA CAN PENETRATE TO THE HOUSING OF THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT FOR THE FRONT SEAT AUTOMATIC SEAT BELTS. LIQUID CONTAMINATION OF THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT CAN CAUSE FAILURE OF THE UNIT SIGNAL NEEDED TO ACTIVATE THE MOVEMENT OF THE MOTORIZED SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE.
